GitHub Actions workflow for ledger backtest benchmarks, comparison, publishing, and PR comments.

# Purpose
This GitHub Actions workflow runs a ledger backtest benchmark and compares the current commit against `main`. It builds the project twice, first for the baseline and then for the new changes, and it runs `run_ledger_backtest.sh` to collect slot time, total elapsed time, snapshot load time, and memory usage. The workflow then computes ratios and percentage changes, writes them to `benchmark.json`, and publishes the results with `benchmark-action/github-action-benchmark@v1`. When the workflow runs for a pull request or issue comment, it also posts a Markdown comment that shows the baseline, new values, and change status for each measurement.
